name: B10-0435/2026 – After recital G – Am 7
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the state of play of advancing EU-Africa trade and investment relations
part_text: Ga. whereas, alongside the EPAs, a large number of African countries, including most of the continent’s least developed countries, benefit from unilateral trade preferences under the Everything But Arms arrangement of the Generalised Scheme of Preferences (GSP); whereas the revised GSP Regulation1a, applicable from 1 January 2027, allows for the temporary withdrawal of preferences where a beneficiary country fails to cooperate sufficiently on the readmission of its own nationals irregularly present in the EU; \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 1a Regulation (EU) 2026/1395 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 17 June 2026 on applying a generalised scheme of tariff preferences and repealing Regulation (EU) No 978/2012 (OJ L, 2026/1395, 22.6.2026, ELI: [http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2026/1395/oj](http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2026/1395/oj)).
